name: Puckoff: Reloaded
storyline:
You are [Insert Name Here] and have just moved to Puckville, because you have heard of legends that the World's Best Warrior, Living Legend Dominator was last seen playing there. Your dream is to meet him and maybe even play a game of hockey with your idol. A random set of events launches you to an adventure, where you get on the bus and go on a World Tour with a random barkeep and an Action Girl you just met at Puckville.

Your coach is a Grumpy Old Man who rarely has anything positive to say about your game. World tour takes you around the world with each country having its own Boss Battle. Through these characters the mystery of solving who is Beneath the Mask is getting closer.
summary: Puckoff: Reloaded is the latest, and greatest, version of the (in)famous game, Puckoff, previously available only for personal computers. Enter the world of no-rules hockey as a total newbie and work on your skills and attitude to meet with the mythical terrorizer, Dominator. Build your team of has-beens and legends while learning different playstyles to defeat a plethora of colorful characters around the globe. Team up with the ever cheerful Sarah, the best beer-league goalie Eddie, and the ever grumpy seen-it-all Coach. So grab your skates and Puck off!
